entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eugène Tremblay was a Canadian prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who served as Bishop of the Diocese of Amos from 2004 until his retirement in 2011. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Quebec.
